dispatch_fields.note: E0GlobalBTZ on every T2, connected, second-countable E0-manifold: the component of sing_0(M) through p is the range of an inextensible causal curve gamma : R -> M, gamma 0 = p, a closed embedding when M is causal. Built by a maximal-extension construction (§6e, generic: a closed preconnected set S with a line chart at every point and a finite atomless measure nu positive on relatively open subsets of S). Good curves = causal curves into S of nu-unit speed (nu(c(]s,s'[)) = s'-s); local uniqueness via the chart measure rho = T_*(nu|O∩S) on ]a,b[; local existence by reparametrising the chart by the distribution function of rho; the union of all good curves through p is one good curve (maxCurve over the open interval maxDom), its image is clopen in S hence S, it has no limit at either end (a limit y would sit on the curve at a later parameter), so reparametrised by R it is inextensible by Causal.Flat.inextensible_univ_of_not_tendsto; causal => injective and a closed map => closed embedding. No classification of 1-manifolds and no time function (the field has no GH hypothesis): a circle component of a non-causal M is a periodic good curve. nu = exists_line_measure's lambda_1. The E0 line chart: the axis of chartAt x inverted by the paper time read in the chart, monotone along <=_O (ChartIso + E0.le_axis_iff'), a causal curve in every open set (e0_le_ball_of_axis in a ball inside the chart image).

E0LineStep with NO second countability of M (GH only; the Cauchy surface is not needed for the step): mu = Lebesgue measure in countably many regular chart isomorphisms (Reg M second countable => S_0^c Lindelof, exists_chart_measure_on_of_isLindelof); the future volume x -> mu(J+(x)) is strictly decreasing (closedness of J+ under GH, Z+, I-(BTZ)=empty) and continuous (closedness of J-, frontier I+ null, J+ in closure I+ by push-up) along every line chart, hence a local homeomorphism of the component L into R, so L is second countable (strict Causal.secondCountableTopology_of_isLocalHomeomorph); L Lindelof gives lambda_1 on L (exists_line_measure_of_isLindelof) and §6e's construction gives the inextensible line. Then e0_secondCountable_of_lineStep (round 1) closes the field. The dispatch's suggested route (Levin time function on M) needs SC of M and was not usable; the future volume replaces it along the line.

kb_proposals: A model fact transfers to every admissible M only if it is stated in every open set W of Y (the ChartIso of chartAt relates relations of U to relations of chartImage U, never of top); strong causality + causal arc-connectedness turns a top-level fact into its every-open form (GX.E0LM.rel_of_causallyConvex).

Global facts at BTZ points of a charted M (I^-(p) empty, past_local) come from absolute minimality: the last link of a TransGen chain lies in some chart domain; chart independence of sing_alpha is sing_mem on the transition.

Push-up of E_0 in every open set: propagate along the causal curve by real induction on [0,1] (GX.E0LM.prop_one_of_up / prop_zero_of_down); regular points through the sector chart (ChartIso + minkowski_pushUp), axis points through E0.Iplus_ball_axis and a perturbation f(w) > tau_a.

Causal.gxGroupoid (lean-causal) and GX.gxGroupoid (lean-gx) are distinct definitions; the strict Causal.Flat.flat_secondCountableTopology needs the Causal one, which has no ClosedUnderRestriction instance at ca2ad78 (prove it by closedUnderRestriction_iff_id_le + Causal.mem_gxGroupoid_of_eq_id, GX.E0LM.flatGroupoid_closedUnderRestriction).

The regular part of a singular manifold is a (G,X)-manifold on the subtype: charts (chartAt).trans c with c in the regular atlas, then subtypeRestr; transitions by OpenPartialHomeomorph.subtypeRestr_symm_trans_subtypeRestr + closedUnderRestriction' (GX.E0LM.e0RegM_hasGroupoid).

A dense open R of a preconnected space is preconnected if every point has an open V with V cap R preconnected (GX.E0LM.isPreconnected_e0RegM: the sets of points with a neighbourhood whose R-part lies in u, resp. v, are open, disjoint by density, and cover).
With Levin (Causal.LevinUtility) a time function needs only T2 + SC + tarentin + GH: no measures, no SingularFlatAxioms.

A 1-dimensional locus with local increasing charts is parametrised globally WITHOUT the classification of 1-manifolds by a canonical parameter: nu-unit speed for an atomless measure nu positive on open arcs (GX.E0LM.GoodAt). Unit-speed curves are locally unique and exist locally, so the union of all of them through p is one curve (GX.E0LM.maxCurve); clopen image + no limit at the ends + Causal.Flat.inextensible_univ_of_not_tendsto give the inextensible line; the circle case needs no separate treatment (periodic curve).
Causal.Flat.inextensible_univ_of_not_tendsto: a causal curve over R with no limit at either end is inextensible, with no hypothesis on the causality; it is the cheapest route to Inextensible.

On a GH spacetime that is not known to be second countable, the future volume x -> mu(J+(x)) of a finite measure built on a second-countable open part (Reg M) is a time function along any curve in its complement (GX.E0LM.futureVolume_strictAntiOn / _continuousOn), enough to make a 1-dimensional locus second countable through Causal.secondCountableTopology_of_isLocalHomeomorph (GX.E0LM.secondCountable_of_lineCharts).
exists_chart_measure_on / exists_line_measure use second countability only for a countable subcover: the IsLindelof versions (…_of_isLindelof) need neither SC nor metrizability of M.

Every open interval I ∋ 0 of R is the range of a strictly increasing continuous phi : R -> R with phi 0 = 0 (GX.E0LM.exists_strictMono_range_eq); build halves t ↦ sSup I · |t|/(1+|t|) (or id when unbounded) and get the lower half by applying the upper one to -I.
A LineChart depends on its base point: rewriting `c t₀ = d t₀` in a goal mentioning `ch : LineChart C S (c t₀)` fails (motive not type correct); introduce `w` with `c t₀ = w`, take the chart at `w`.
